There were already going to be several different pies at our Thanksgiving celebration, so I wanted to make something a little different this year.

I made sweet potato icecream with a simple base (half and half, cream, sugar, tempered egg yolk), that I blended smooth with a baked, mashed and cooled sweet potato. The video above is the icecream churning in the tumbler.

I didn't snap a pic of the finished product because today was a little hectic, but after the ice cream was done, I put it in a casserole dish, swirled in homemade salted caramel, and topped it with toasted pecans and marshmallows.

This is my play on a classic sweet potato casserole/candied yams dish. In my experience, no matter whose family we visit for Thanksgiving, the sweet potato dish is so incredibly sweet, it might as well be a dessert.
